name: Mystery Paradise
author: Addicting Games
description: Mystery Paradise is a puzzle game where you must match 3 or more of the same marbles. This is a game based on a tropical and mysterious paradise. Deep in this rainforest, you have found this unusual puzzle full of brightly colored marbles that you must match together. Make the colored tiles disappear by matching the marbles on top of them. Each level has its own challenges with different grids and different positioned colored backgrounds. There are 30 levels of this game for you to solve! This is a casual puzzle game but you still must beat the clock before you lose that level. If you lose, you can play it again until you solve it in time. When you beat all 30 levels of this online game, click on the high scores button from the main menu to see if your score was good enough to land there.
